title: Accurate energies of nS, nP, nD, nF, and nG levels of neutral cesium
method: Doppler-free resonantly enhanced two-photon spectroscopy in a thermionic diode, Fabry-Perot wavelength calibration against I2-stabilized He-Ne
uncertainty: 95% confidence: 0.00015 cm^-1 (p, f, g series), 0.00020 cm^-1 (s, d series and all Table II levels) unless given in parentheses (then 0.0005 cm^-1 for 4-decimal values)
conversion: Rows without uncertainty are not exported: ['6S1/2'].

Energies from '6s 2S1/2 hyperfine center of gravity', energy zero: Measured from 6S1/2 F=4 and increased by 0.13415 cm^-1 by the authors (= 7/16 of the ground hfs), excited levels reduced to their hfs centres of gravity; pressure-shift corrected.
caveats: 31S1/2 (31260.38452 cm^-1) as printed in the S column is inconsistent with the S series (it gives the P1/2 quantum defect 3.592); probable misplacement in the source; flagged in levels.csv, exclude from S fits
energies at low n (n<=10) include values with larger uncertainty (0.0005 cm^-1, marked (5))
thermal-vapor measurement: pressure-shift corrections applied by the authors (up to +0.00008 cm^-1)
